note: Snares (Steve 2026-10-25, plan tech/ACTION_PLANS/Steve_hide_traps.md). A set snare (struct kind snare_trap) is rolled only when an animal passes it (pass_note) or, once, when a player comes back within active_m after time away (away_note); nothing runs for it otherwise. The chance of a catch on a pass is base_chance x the worn-trail factor at the snare x the species weight of the passing animal x bait x night x storm; luck nudges the roll (fate kind snare). A catch takes that animal out of the world and lays its carcass beside the snare (the knife flow, parts, hide and rot are the carcass module's); the snare is quiet avoid_s game seconds (10 game minutes) afterwards and wears wear_per_catch and breaks at its durability. While its carcass still lies there the snare is sprung and catches nothing. Deer and bigger are never caught (species not in species_weight). All numbers here.
test_chance_note: Smoke runs only (Tyler 25 Oct): above 0, every look at a set snare catches an imagined rabbit with this chance; the server prints a line at load while it is on. Keep 0.

tracking.note: Tracking practice (Dave 23 Nov 2026: 'you should get xp for placing snares on trails'; the rest a coordinator pick for his review). A snare set where trail_at is snare_min or more trains it (skills.json track_snare), but not within snare_spot_m of a spot where that character's snare trained it in the last snare_spot_s game seconds (no farming by taking one up and setting it again). A player on a trail (trail_at follow_min or more) who has walked follow_m since the last check_s look is following it (track_follow). Catches train it too (track, at the carcass). Tuned so a player who tracks and traps reaches Tracking 10 (the map's trails) in a few hours: about 970 units, a gain of about 5.4 units a practice, at most two a minute from following, slowed by the skill's soft day cap (300 units a game day, an hour): about 3 to 4 hours.
tracking.sign_note: Spotting a trail sign (Dave 23 Nov 2026: 'spotting animal markings should highlight the markings, make a slight sound and give xp for finding them'; protocol 153): trains Tracking (track_sign) once per sign per character in sign_spot_s game seconds (3 game days), a sign within sign_same_m of one found being the same sign; only for a spot within sign_reach_m of the player with a trail within sign_trail_m, and from the Tracking the first signs show (trail_signs.json see_level).

marks_note: The Map's trap marks (protocol 150): each owner's list is read at most every marks_refresh_s real seconds (a trap set shows at once, one taken up within this), and traps of one kind within a metre are one mark.
pass_note: Dave 22 Nov 2026: once a snare is out the server does no work for it. A caught-able animal stepping within lure_m of a set snare (the animals step only near players) gets one roll: base_chance x the trail factor x species weight x bait x night x storm x choke. A snare off any animal trail (trail strength or run share under on_trail_min) never catches, so it is never rolled. No draw: animals are not pulled to snares, they come by on their runs.
species_weight_note: Part C plan 3 (10 Nov 2026): birds are caught by the bird trap, not the snare (item_system), so the duck is off the snare's list. A species with no carcass.json row is never caught (the catch would leave nothing).
run_note: TR-6 (22 Nov 2026, docs/design/ANIMAL_ROUTINES_TRAILS_TRAPPING.md): a snare set right on a trail between animal places (server_ranges.gd), within run_full_m of its line, counts as a fully worn trail; the share falls to nothing at run_none_m. Snares are set on the run itself, where the feet land (Shooting UK; MeatEater; Wildwood).
choke_note: TR-12 (stage 2c): a snare on a rabbit run (the run it notes, away_run_kind) within choke_m of a tree's root or a boulder's edge sits at a choke point, where the run squeezes and the animal cannot step round the noose; its chance (live and while away) is x choke_mult. Off any run a choke does nothing. Placed logs and fences do not count (they settle the ground and the animals leave it). Provisional.
away_fox_note: TR-10 (stage 2b): a snare on a run within away_fox_m of a fox earth (its rounds pass there) may take a fox while nobody is near, at away_fox_share of the rabbit rate times the fox's activity now; the catch is a fox or a rabbit in proportion to their chances. Foxes walk the rabbits' runs as they hunt them; the live snare already takes a fox near it (species_weight 0.4).
away_note: D-TRAP-1 (22 Nov 2026): with nobody within active_m, nothing is done; when a player next comes within active_m (looked for every check_s round each player only), a snare on a rabbit run (trail kind 0) rolls once for the whole game hours since: each hour away_per_hour x the trail factor x the rabbits' activity at that hour x bait x storm, over the latest away_max_hours; no animal is simulated or taken. About 0.045 gives a snare squarely on a run about two catches in five nights (dusk to dawn) and about one a game day in two, near Wildwood's 3 hares in 15 snares the first night; off a run nothing. How squarely it sits on a run is noted on the snare while a player is near (the places are worked out only then). A sprung snare holds its catch until it is taken.
no_cap_note: Dave 22 Nov 2026: no limit on how many snares or bird traps a player sets (was 6 each, the oldest taken back).
say_near: A snare needs open ground, well away from buildings.
say_broke: A snare broke on its catch.

bird_trap_set.note: The Bird trap (Part C plan 3, 10 Nov 2026): the bird_trap kit is set like a snare (struct kind bird_trap_set), with these numbers laid over the snare's. It catches only ground birds (species_weight); a bird that walks within its lure_m gets one roll (no draw, Dave 22 Nov 2026). Birds keep to no runs, so it needs no trail and the worn-trail factor is flat; they roost at night (night_mult under 1). Grain or other food within bait_m baits it.
bird_trap_set.say_near: A bird trap needs open ground, well away from buildings.
bird_trap_set.say_broke: A bird trap broke on its catch.
